about:
Kingston Krafts operates from Cranston, Rhode Island, as a family-owned and operated small business. The company specializes in custom metal and wood furniture and fixtures, drawing on the region’s industrial heritage.

The workshop fabricates bar tops, countertops, dining tables, and custom furniture using zinc, copper, brass, bronze, and solid wood. Customers can specify custom length, width, height, and top thickness on most products, and choose from standard finishes or custom patinas. An in-house design team provides expert advice, and the company ships nationwide with free shipping; installation services are available in the Northeast and Southeast United States.

Kingston Krafts serves both commercial and residential clients. Its portfolio ranges from small cafes to large casinos, supplying metal and wood surfaces for hospitality and home environments.

The founders frame their ethos around the legacy of the American Industrial Revolution, aiming to build beautiful, well-designed products that last a lifetime. They emphasize the challenge of custom work and pride in their standard collections, positioning the business as part of Rhode Island’s creative revival.
